questions: What is scaffolding?
Once the scaffolding is removed, does everything still stand?
What is tracking?
If the tracking is wrong, do you end up in the wrong place?
What is accommodation?
If the accommodation is taken away, do you have to leave?
What is feedback?
If the feedback is bad, do you turn it down?
What is placement?
If the placement does not work out, do you have to start over?
What is alignment?
If the alignment is off, does it pull to one side?
What is standardization?
If standardization increases, does everyone have to do it exactly the same way?
What is validity?
When validity expires, can it still be used?
What is retention?
When retention ends, is everything deleted?
What is dropout?
If dropout rises, does the system become more robust?
What is an intervention?
If the intervention ends, does the problem come back?
What is transfer?
If the transfer goes through, has something changed hands?
What is capital?
If capital grows, are you richer?
What is a portfolio?
If the portfolio is weak, does it mean you have less money?
What is a credential?
If your credential is accepted, are you automatically let in?
